svg.title: Плавание брассом — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Breaststroke swimming, oblique above-water view, two separate full-body snapshots arranged side by side. LEFT face down, BOTH arms straight together forward overhead, BOTH legs fully extended behind and together during glide. RIGHT head raised slightly, both arms symmetrically bent to sweep in under chest and both heels draw toward hips preparing a symmetric frog kick. Flat sparse water lines only, modest jammers. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
